meta.title: Rementum — Self-hosted, versioned memory for AI agents
meta.description: Rementum is a self-hosted, open-source memory layer for AI agents: versioned Markdown knowledge, staged conflict-checked writes, and OAuth-secured MCP access you control.

hero.subtitle: One versioned knowledge layer for every MCP client. Rementum stages each write for review before it replaces shared memory.

howItWorks.subtitleA: How your agents stay synchronized without overwriting each other
howItWorks.animationLabel: Illustrated overview: agents read a compact index, stage writes, and share one versioned brain

steps.title: Compact Routing Index
steps.desc: You query a compact index of titles, summaries, keywords, and freshness, then open the one article you need. You leave the rest of the brain alone.

steps.title: Staged Write Isolation
steps.desc: You stage each proposal as written in a buffer tied to its base version, apart from live canon.

steps.title: Conflict Resolution Shield
steps.desc: Rementum checks the article for changes since you staged your write. You review each conflict and decide what lands.

steps.title: Immutable Versioned Canon
steps.desc: You promote. Rementum encrypts the change with AES-256-GCM and commits an audited, immutable version. Your agents read the new version on their next call.

pricing.subtitle: Rementum is open source, with no paid tier and no per-seat billing. You run it on your own hardware and own every byte.
pricing.priceBody: Clone it, run one install script, and connect an agent over MCP.
advantages: Free forever, with no seats, usage caps, or paywalled features
Your data stays on your server; the master key never leaves it
Unlimited brains, workspaces, agents, and versions
Full source under AGPL-3.0 to audit, fork, and extend
Bring your own AI provider, or run on local models alone
considerations: You provide the Linux host, a domain, and open ports 80 and 443
You run updates, encrypted backups, and the occasional migration
Scaling and uptime are yours to size and monitor
No hosted SaaS tier; self-hosting is the only path today

connectTeaser.title: Give your agents a memory.
connectTeaser.subtitle: You host Rementum on your own server and connect over MCP. The plugin adds its skills and tools to your coding agent, and you approve each grant in your browser.

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.subtitle: Recent changes across your brains and the writes that need your review.
dashboard.noWorkspaceBody: Create a team and workspace to collect brains and invite members.
dashboard.noBrainsBody: Connect an agent over MCP to create your first brain. It will appear here with its articles, staged writes, and activity.

agentConnect.title: Connect {workspace} to an agent.
agentConnect.body: Pick your agent, install the Rementum plugin or skills, then connect MCP. Your browser will ask you to approve this workspace. Restart the agent when setup completes.
